experiment_validation.text: Validation: re-analysing the 85 rhizome–root and rhizome–aerial-stem comparisons of atlas studies this way reproduces the published study-level trait indices exactly from orthogroup counts and with r = 0.95–1.00 from Arabidopsis or crop-genome identifiers. The most similar species is in the same lineage for 62% (vs root) and 74% (vs aerial stem) of these comparisons (chance 41% and 47%), and in the same family for 36% and 23% (chance 6% and 8%).
